## The teacher's additional rules (apply them when giving feedback)
- 别人：别人/别的 is to distinguish all others from the spoken one
- “不是……而是……” is used to refute something conventional and affirm something unexpected, and to correct something wrong
- 从Time开始
- ……的时候：的is needed, except monosyllabic + 时候 (小时候，古时候)
- 毒：cannot be used with 很，非常，太，得很，for Adj. use 有毒的
- Why 古代的时候 is problematic: 古代 is a time, ……的时候 also means “time of”, it is redundant.
- 害得structure: 害得 + someone + harmful result (clause)
- 决定 + VP.: no need to repeat pronouns/reference after “决定”
- 恐怕 cannot take other Subj. except for 我 before it. The correct structure is: 我恐怕…… or 恐怕 + Clause (Subj. + VP.). 恐怕 in Chinese means "I'm afraid that...", not just "be afraid of". So 担心 and 害怕 are correct to express Subj. is afraid that....
- 了 placement: V. + Resultative + 了 (wrong: V. 了Resultative), 去V. + 了 (wrong: 去了V.)
- 难怪……，原来……
- 人：人 is a generic noun, not used to refer to a concrete group of people. Use 人们.
- "位" is very polite and formal, not appropriate for an ordinary person in a story (一个叫神农的男人, not 一位叫神农的男人).
- 也 + VP.: 也 cannot be directly followed by noun or clause.
- 一V就……：“就“ is needed
- 再 structure: modal verb + 再 + V. + Num. + MW. + Obj.
- Mix 这就要看……了 and 了：“了” in “这就要看……了” is just part of this structure, not about completion or not.
- 这/那 + MW. + Noun.
- 只有：not才有
- 自己 (coherence/reference): When the possessor is the same person as the subject, often use 自己的 to make that relationship clear.

## The teacher's additional rules (apply them when giving feedback)
- 别人：别人/别的 is to distinguish all others from the spoken one
- “不是……而是……” is used to refute something conventional and affirm something unexpected, and to correct something wrong
- 从Time开始
- ……的时候：的is needed, except monosyllabic + 时候 (小时候，古时候)
- 毒：cannot be used with 很，非常，太，得很，for Adj. use 有毒的
- Why 古代的时候 is problematic: 古代 is a time, ……的时候 also means “time of”, it is redundant.
- 害得structure: 害得 + someone + harmful result (clause)
- 决定 + VP.: no need to repeat pronouns/reference after “决定”
- 恐怕 cannot take other Subj. except for 我 before it. The correct structure is: 我恐怕…… or 恐怕 + Clause (Subj. + VP.). 恐怕 in Chinese means "I'm afraid that...", not just "be afraid of". So 担心 and 害怕 are correct to express Subj. is afraid that....
- 了 placement: V. + Resultative + 了 (wrong: V. 了Resultative), 去V. + 了 (wrong: 去了V.)
- 难怪……，原来……
- 人：人 is a generic noun, not used to refer to a concrete group of people. Use 人们.
- "位" is very polite and formal, not appropriate for an ordinary person in a story (一个叫神农的男人, not 一位叫神农的男人).
- 也 + VP.: 也 cannot be directly followed by noun or clause.
- 一V就……：“就“ is needed
- 再 structure: modal verb + 再 + V. + Num. + MW. + Obj.
- Mix 这就要看……了 and 了：“了” in “这就要看……了” is just part of this structure, not about completion or not.
- 这/那 + MW. + Noun.
- 只有：not才有
- 自己 (coherence/reference): When the possessor is the same person as the subject, often use 自己的 to make that relationship clear.

## Grammar & Vocabulary Corrections
- 找到孟子一个老师：给孟子找了一个老师，Use 给 to introduce the person who receives the benefit of the action; the completed action also needs 了.
- 跟老师孟子学最重要的文学：孟子跟老师学最重要的文学，Place the subject before the phrase showing who the learner studies with.

## Vocabulary Suggestions
- 文学 -- “学最重要的文学”：文学作品, specifies that he is studying literary texts rather than the academic field in general；经典文学作品, identifies works that are widely regarded as important.

## Coherence & Expressiveness
- Coherence (Reference): 他的朋友：自己的朋友，Use 自己的 when the possessor is the same person as the subject, making it clear that the friends are his own.
- Coherence (Reference): 他的城市：自己的城市，Use 自己的 to show clearly that the city is the one he does not want to leave.
- Coherence (Temporality): 成为哲学家：成为了哲学家，Use 了 after 成为 to mark the completed change of state.
- Coherence (Conjunction): 他难怪抱怨，他想他的朋友，因为他不要离开他的城市：他抱怨，因为他想念自己的朋友，也不想离开自己的城市，难怪 needs a result followed or supported by an explanation, often with 原来; here 因为 introduces the reasons for his complaint, and 也 links the two parallel reasons.
- Expressiveness: At the point where he complains, add his feeling of reluctance: “孟子很不舍得离开自己的朋友。”
- Expressiveness: You could add a short line of quoted speech to show his complaint: “孟子说：‘我不想离开这座城市！’”
- Expressiveness: When his mother finds a teacher, add her purpose or hope: “妈妈希望孟子能好好学习。”

## Encouragement
- You clearly connect the boy’s complaint with his attachment to his friends and city. You also give the scene a strong long-term outcome by showing that he later becomes a philosopher.
